A sustainable point‑to‑point service offering Libreng Sakay to the patrons of Robinsons Galleria and Bridgetowne Destination Estate. Operating from 6 AM to 8 PM with a capacity of 30–35 passengers, this PWD‑friendly service will run 8 trips per unit per day and will operate 7 days a week, excluding holidays. Pick‑up points will be located at Robinsons Galleria’s steel parking lay‑by and between Tera Tower and Opus Mall in Bridgetowne Destination Estate. The Libreng Sakay initiative supports modern, eco‑friendly mobility for the public which will be launched this summer.
